program='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] == 2 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            if all(grid[r0][x] == 2 and grid[r1][x] == 2 for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[y][c0] == 2 and grid[y][c1] == 2 for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
                interior = [(y,x) for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1)]
                color = sum(grid[y][x] == 0 for y,x in interior) % 10
                for y,x in interior:
                    if grid[y][x] == 0:
                        out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
